reason: If it really answered my support emails at night I'd pay 99 € without blinking, but this sounds like another tool I'd have to connect, feed a knowledge base and babysit. At most I'd poke at the free plan, I wouldn't pay this month.
objection: I don't have time to set it up and learn another tool, and our CRM is a mess nobody updates, so I doubt it learns my business well enough to be trusted with customers.
would_change_my_mind: Their onboarding team setting it up for me in under an hour and showing it answering my real customer emails in my own tone during the demo.
